# sherpa-badge

A small count: Figma "Indicator (atom)/Type=count". The consumer pins its Style mode, as Figma pins the instance.

|---|---|

## When to use it

For a small count, such as unread items. On a `sherpa-button`, set its `data-badge` instead; for a short label in a pill, use `sherpa-tag`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-badge aria-label="3 unread">3</sherpa-badge>
```

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| (default) | text | the count |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`box`
